scriptData.label: @effect.name
Broken Head (Minor)

description.label: Description
description.value:
The arrow buries itself to the fletching in your neck, coming out the other side. You gurgle and spit blood, but although it looks exceedingly dramatic neither major blood vessels nor spine were in the arrow’s path.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (2) and @Condition[Bleeding] (1). Also, you now effectively have a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.nbhn2wX35b7Jrcbg]{Broken Bone (Minor)}, able to neither speak nor eat properly, except that the injury will be healed immediately once Extraction has been performed. You’ll still have to roll a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test to avoid long-term effects.

Extraction will be Hard (-20).
